content: Jesus juranman baja yarkinmun.
Sundaynga mudu-wayjul-wayjulda, bula Mary Magdalene, and Mary yindu, bula dungan, juljal nyajinka.
Jinbalku bubu yaykarrku bulngajin. Angel Majandamun bada kadan, heavenmun, kulji yiringkan bulkajimun, wuyar bundan kuljinga.
Nyulu dayirr bajaku yala balbay, nyungu kambi bingaji bajaku.
Jana soldier-soldier miyilji bundandan, jana yinyilmarinyarrkukuda, yararrin-yararrin yinyilji, dararin, yala yarkin wunanarin.
Nyulu angelangka jalbu-bulalanda yalaman, “Yubal kari yinyilmaka. Ngayu binal yubal Jesusanka nubin-nubiji. Jana nyungun jukungu walngkan-daman.
Nyulu yaluy kari. Nyulu dakaynda yala nyuluku ngadiku balkankuda. Kaday yaluy, yanyu bubu nyajinka nyulu wunanan.
Jinbal dungayda, nyunguwunbu jawun-karranda balka, ‘Nyulu dakaynda yarkinmun. Nyulu jakalba bubungu Galilee dungay, yurranka. Yinyaymba yurra nyungun nyajilkuda. Yinyada kuku ngayuda wundin.”
Jalbu-bulalangka jinbaldaku juljal bawan. Bula yinyilman, yamba bula same time wawurr-wawurrmaynda. Bula warrin, jawun-karranda balkanka.
Jesus, nyulu nguwimal milbijinda jalbu-bulalanda. Nyulu yalaman, “Yubal wawurr-wawurrmaka.” Bula nyungundu kadan, bungkubu janan, nyungu jina karrban, nyungun buyay-manin.
Jesusangka bulanda yalaman, “Kari yinyilmaka. Dungay ngaykuwunbu jawun-karranda, jananda balka bubungu Galilee dungarinka. Jana nganya yinyabi nyajil.”
Soldier-soldier jurrilman.
Jalbu-bulal dungan-dunganda, kanbalda soldier-soldierangka miyil-kujin-kujin juljal, jana dungarin baja townbuku. Jana junjuy-junjuy wubulku balkan maja-majanda Godundumunbu bayanba.
Jana, maja-maja Godundumunbu bayanba, and council-council, jana murumarin, yanday-bungan. Jana money jirray dajin soldier-soldieranda.
Jana soldier-soldieranda balkan jurril-bunganka. Jana soldier-soldieranda yalaman, “Yurra bamanda jurril balka, yurra warngku wunanan, Jesusamu jawun-karra kadarin, yarkin ngakinda.”
Jana yalaman baja, “Kaki Majangka Pilateangka yinya kuku nyajil yurra warngku wunananya, nganjin nyungundu balkalda yurrangan kari punishim-bunganka. Yurra yinyaynka kari milka-bujarmaka baja.”

Jana soldier-soldierangka yinya money manin, bama jurril-bungan yala maja-majangka jananda balkan. Bamangka Jew-warrangka still yinya kuku jurril believeim-bungalku, jana still yinyaynka balkal-balkawayku.
Jesus nguwimal milbijin nyunguwunbu jawun-karranda.
Jawun-karra 11-bala wuburrbu dungarin bubungu Galilee. Jesusangka jananda jakalbaku balkan yinyaymba wuburrbu dungarinka.
Jana nyungun nyajin, nyungun buyay-maninda, worshipim-bungan. Yamba kanbalda warmbin, balu nyulu bama yindu, yamba nyulu Jesuskuda.
Jesus, nyulu yuba kadan, jananda yalaman, “Godungku nganya maja-bungan, wubulbuku heavenba, bamanga wubulbuku bubungu.

Dungayda, bamanda wubulbuku yiringkurrku, bubungu yindu-yinduymbu. Jananin binal-bunga ngayku bamamanka. Jananin banabu dukul-dama. Jananda balkada, ‘Yurranga majakuda Nganjanda, Kangkalda, Wawu dayirrda.’

Jananin binal-bunga yinya kuku nyajinka ngayu yurranda balkan. Milka-janay! Ngayu wuljaljiku yurranji bundaykuda, ngulkurrduku kujinka. Bubu kunbayda wayjuji, ngayu still yurranin ngulkurrduku kujil-kujilkuda.” Yalakubada.
